provenance.method: band probe: one band's FFNs -> q2_k at a time, rest at base; delta vs reference. Source was Q8_0; the probe builds its own Q6_K reference and Q6_K band files internally, so base_quant matches the qwen3.5-35b entry by construction and the sibling comparison is controlled.
provenance.note: fragility_ratio 2.53 uses the atlas convention - worst delta over the TRUE median of the four bands (0.1649). The probe's own log line prints '+0.42 vs median 0.19' (~2.2x) because it displays a rounded upper-middle value; both numbers describe the same curve and neither is wrong. Same divergence disclosed on the qwen3.8-27b entry. Staked in prereg #103 before the source was quantized; all three predictions passed.
provenance.payoff: Tested at EQUAL BYTES (prereg #104, 2026-08-18): holding these ten layers at Q4_K instead of ten evenly-spread layers - byte-identical files, 14,115,658,720 bytes each - measured 5.7796 PPL against 5.9088, removing 29.2% of the quality loss over a Q6_K reference at no size cost, with decode unchanged (1.22%). Evidence: weights/data/prereg104_ppl.log.

published_artifact.note: The depth-aware build from this recipe. Decode is a RANGE on a box this size, not a point: 11.0-14.4 tok/s at -ngl 12 on a GTX 1060 6GB, cold to warm, because the file (13.15 GiB) is larger than free RAM (~12.2 GB) and cannot stay page-cache resident. Six consecutive runs of one unchanged command climbed 13.04 -> 14.43; a 4.68 GB model that fits holds a 2.1% spread. This entry previously quoted 14.86 +/- 0.36 as a point estimate and that figure was not reproduced in six attempts - corrected 2026-08-18 under prereg #106 (scored 2/4, P-1 and P-3 refuted). See L-29, D-29, C-32. Its model card carries the fragility curve, the equal-bytes comparison, and the one prediction left unscored.
